races.name: HoBOOken 5K Race - Usatf Certified Course

races.name: Hop Skip and Splash 5K Fun Run/Walk

races.name: Hot Cider Hustle - Wheaton 8 Mile Run & 5K Run/Walk

races.name: Howl-o-ween 5k - Dan Ryan Woods

races.name: Jsrc Deal Trick or Trot

races.name: Miles For Smiles: 3.1 for 31

races.name: Race for the Refuge

races.name: Riverside Foundation Halloween Hustle 5K Walk or Run
races.street: Half Day Brewing Company - 200 Village Green S

races.name: Run for the Hills

races.name: Run the Vineyards - Rocklands Farm 5K

races.name: Savage 7k

The projects they are raising money for this year are a new exterior sign and a curtain for the stage, and installing a gas insert for the stone fireplace.

races.name: Scaredy Cat K95K

races.name: Lasd Elite Team Relay Battle of the Badges
races.summary: Join us for the first LASD Elite Team Relay. Battle of the Badges 2027.

races.name: Little Patuxent River Half Marathon, 10K, & 5K

Starting and finishing at the Guilford Pratt Truss Bridge, the half marathon (13.1 miles), 10K (6.55 miles) and 5K (3.1 miles) takes place on the Patuxent and Wincopin trails. The course runs along the Little Patuxent and Middle Patuxent River.

races.name: NYRR Manhattan 10K
races.regStatus: Sold out. NYRR members can apply to the Member-Only Standby List.

races.name: Run Like It's Recess 5K
races.summary: 16th Annual Run Like It's Recess 5K Run/Walk, 1K, and Toddler Run. 5K Start Time: 9:00 a.m. 1K Start Time: 10:15 a.m. Toddler Run Start Time: 10:45 a.m. This annual event is hosted by Newcomb Academy PTSA, which serves Newcomb Academy (Grades K-8), a public school in the Long Beach Unified School District.

races.name: The Great Stew Chase
races.summary: The Great Stew Chase is a 15-kilometer road race held annually in Lynn, Mass. organized by the Wyoma Lions Club. The race is the third oldest 15K in the US, having started in 1975. The 51st event will be held on Sunday, January 31, 2027. Most run the full 15K at 10:00AM. Two alternatives are offered.

races.name: Time Travel Half Marathon/5K/10K - Austin
races.summary: Ready, Set. Time Travel! ️. Lace up your sneakers and prepare to dash through the Time Travel Half Marathon (5K/10K) - a family-friendly race that’s truly timeless! Whether you're a future sprinter or a blast-from-the-past jogger, this event is all about fun, fitness, family, and a little bit of funky flair.

races.name: All-Out Mardi Crawl
races.summary: Get ready for the 11th annual Mardi Crawl, where we blend a wonderful winter run with a festive Mardi Gras celebration, Colorado-style! Starting from the amazing Colorado Tap House in Arvada, you can choose your challenge: relatively gentle 5K and 10K courses, or a more challenging half marathon course.

races.name: Citrus College Athletics Super 5K
races.summary: A fun 5K and 1K for the kids around the Citrus College campus during the Big Game weekend. Come out and experience the Citrus College campus, with music, games, and more. all for a great cause, the Citrus College Athletics Department!

races.name: Clueless & Breathless 5K, 10K & Half
races.summary: Like, ugh, are you seriously going to miss this? Step into your platform shoes and strut into the Clueless & Breathless 5K, 10K & Half Marathon, a 90s-inspired run packed with mall glam, plaid, and way too much lip gloss. Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races.

races.name: Dalton Canyon Ultra

races.name: Golden Gate Trail Run

races.name: Griffith Park Run
races.summary: Run GPR is almost here, mark your calendar! Open to runners and walkers of all levels, from elite athletes to first-timers. This is the only half marathon that covers all the major trails of Griffith Park, with a special reward for the first male and female runners to conquer the final peak. Prefer shorter?

races.street: Start Line Location: Griffith Park in the heart of Los Angeles with a Beautiful, Flat and Fast, Out-And-Back Course
races.summary: Celebrate Easter and the start of Spring by running with your PEEPS® on Sun. March 28th at Griffith Park! Grab your friends, family or any of your other Peeps and get moving! Let your PEEPSONALITY® shine and show every- bunny” what you’re made of in this Inaugural 5k/10k run/walk!

races.name: Cal Tri Austin - 3.28.27

NO DOGS PLEASE! All participants will receive an event t-shirt (while supplies last) and a finisher medal!

races.name: April Fools 4 Miler - Winners Circle Running Club
races.summary: Join us on Saturday, April 3rd at 10 AM for the 44th Annual Winners Circle Running Club's April Fool's 4 Mile Road Race! Fast and flat course. Commemorative gift to those that register by March 7th. Cash prizes for Top 3 Overall Winners Male/Female.

races.name: Big Bear SquaTCh North
races.summary: Sassquad and the New York-New Jersey Trail Conference are proud to present the 6th Annual Harriman Big Bear SquaTCh North at Harriman State Park in Bear Mountain, New York! Join us at 9am on Saturday April 3, 2027 for this trail party!

races.name: Chi Town Half Marathon & 10K
races.summary: Chi Town Half Marathon & 10K - 4/3/2027. Chicago, IL. #ChiTownHalf. Woven between the famed Chicago lakefront and skyline, the Chi Town Half Marathon and 10K tours through Lincoln Park on USATF-certified courses. Aid stations and plenty of toilets will be provided along the course.

races.name: Credit Union Cherry Blossom 5K
races.regStatus: Entry is by lottery for the first time in 2027, open December 14, 2026 to January 5, 2027.
races.summary: The Saturday 5K of Cherry Blossom weekend in Washington, DC.

races.name: DoNot Stop Half Marathon/5K/10K - Greater Chicago
races.summary: Question: Is it supposed to be DO NOT STOP, or DONUT STOP? Answer: YES! Like Running or Walking? Love Donuts? This race is for you! Join us for the annual DoNot Stop Half Marathon, 5k/10k! A donut-themed event that is perfect for the whole family. The fun includes -. Great Swag - designer shirt & custom medal.

races.name: Fool's Dual Half Marathon
races.summary: 5K & Half Marathon! Jump into spring with beautiful ocean views as you run along the scenic coastline on Cape Ann. Kids 5K only $15.00! (12 & under).

races.name: Jsrc RunAPalooza
races.summary: 2027 Registration Opens October 1, 2026. The Jersey Shore Running Club and RunAPalooza race committee are pleased to announce that registration for ALL of our 2027 races Open on October 1, 2026.

races.name: Release the Kraken 5K. 10K. 18 Miler & 50K
races.summary: RELEASE THE KRAKEN. April 3, 2027 | Long Beach, California. 5K • 10K • 18 Mile • 50K. The Kraken has been released -and it’s calling you to the coast. Take on a fast, scenic beachfront course at Release the Kraken, featuring distances for everyone from casual 5K runners to athletes ready to conquer 30 miles.

races.name: RunThrough USA Long Beach 5k,10k & Half Marathon Race
races.summary: Join us for the RunThrough USA Long Beach 5k,10k & Half Marathon Race Weekend. on Saturday 28th March 2026. This popular running location in LA is perfect for not only quick times but some of the most spectacular coastline in the USA!

races.name: Santa Anita Derby Day 5K
races.summary: The 2026 Derby Day 5K is in the books-and what a day. A sold-out 7,500 participants, incredible energy from start to finish, and a full day of celebration in the infield made this one for the record books. Thank you to everyone who ran, walked, volunteered, and cheered-we couldn’t do it without you.

races.name: Spring Fling - Austin
races.summary: Location Confirmed: East Metro Park. Spring Fling Race Series - Let the Good Times Bloom! Presented by Bigfoot Running Company. Shake off the winter chill and welcome the sunshine with the Spring Fling Race Series - the hottest 5K / 10K event of the season!

races.name: Tenacious 10
races.summary: Spring has never felt this good. Join hundreds of runners for Seattle’s most iconic 10K and 10-mile loop around Lake Union. This isn’t just a run-it’s a celebration of everything that makes our city incredible. Start and finish at Gas Works Park. Cruise past Lake Union Park. Wave to the Space Needle.

races.name: The Cobra 5Kai, 10Kai & Half Miyagithon
races.summary: Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races. Strike first. Strike hard. No mercy. Join us for The Cobra 5Kai, 10Kai & Half Miyagithon, an 80s-inspired martial arts throwback run along the LA River Path!

races.name: The Jubilee Mobile Food Pantry Prayer Walk/5K
races.summary: Come join us on Saturday, April 3, 2027, for the second annual Jubilee Mobile Food Pantry Prayer Walk/5K held by Restoring God's Family (RGF) Network. The Jubilee Mobile Food Pantry program is a direct response to the growing issue of food insecurity impacting Williamson County.

races.name: Winnetka Bunny Hop Dash 5k
races.summary: Hop into Spring at the Winnetka Bunny Hop Dash 5k! Join us on April 3, 2027 for a family fun 5k on the Green Bay trail! Start time waves - 8am and 9:00am Rolling start- Bunny Ears included for kids at Finish Line! SCHEDULE. Everyone is Required to Pick Up Packets. Friends can pick up friends packets.

races.name: Cinnamon BUN 5K/10K & 2K PupStrut
races.summary: Kick Off the Spring Running Season - With Cinnamon Buns & Big Smiles! ‍♀️. What better way to welcome spring than with a flat, fast 5K or 10K - and new for 2026, a 2K Pup Strut for you and your furry friend!

races.name: Credit Union Cherry Blossom Ten Mile Run
races.regStatus: Entry is by lottery, open December 14, 2026 to January 5, 2027. Double Blossom (5K + 10 miles) is $114.
races.summary: DC's classic spring 10-miler from the Washington Monument Grounds, timed for the cherry blossoms. Also the USATF 10 Mile Championships.

races.name: Donut Dash
races.summary: Get ready to run, walk, and treat yourself! Join us at Washington Park for the Donut Dash 5K-the ultimate blend of fitness and frosting. Whether you’re racing for a fast 5K time, jogging with friends, or just strolling for the sweet reward at the end, this event is all about fun, community, and delicious pastries.

races.name: Hill Thrill 5k or 10 Mile Road Race (Michelle Benedetti Scholarship Fund)
races.summary: After a wildly successful 4 years, the 5th Annual Michelle Benedetti Memorial Scholarship Fund proudly announces the Hill Thrill Road Race on March 29, 2026. Our afterparty at Maria's on Essex St will also return. In 2025 we had over 400 registrations and will be shooting to beat it!

races.name: The Mass Half

races.name: The Verrazano 10K & 5K Races

This is one of the most historic river fronts in the nation with views of the NYC skyline and the iconic Verrazaon Bridge.

races.name: Three Creeks Half Marathon

races.name: 47th Annual AMS 5K & Wellness Expo VI
races.summary: Locals know this as a popular and inclusive community event that offers a fun family environment focused on physical and spiritual Wellness. Participants walk, jog, run, and/or race. races.summary: The Team Hoyt Memorial Yes You Can Run Together. FEATURING 3 EVENTS:. Team Hoyt Taper - 5 Mile Run perfectly timed to meet the needs of runners as they taper down one week before the Boston Marathon. We run 5 miles to honor the same distance of the first race Dick & Rick ran together.

races.name: Wild Blossom Wine Run 5k
races.summary: THIS EVENT WILL SELL OUT SO SIGN UP NOW! Like Running or Walking? Love Wine? This race is for you! Join us on Saturday, April 10, 2027 with 8:00am, 9:00am, 10:00am and 11:00am starts times (you will select your start time during registration) for an exciting annual event at Wild Blossom Meadery & Winery.

races.name: =PR= Races: Spring Classic 10K
races.summary: Head into spring with a great 10K. Join us on Sunday, April 11 at One Loudoun at 8:00 am for the =PR= Spring Classic 10K. Run through the beautiful Ashburn neighborhoods, enjoy the view and test your endurance. Click for the Packet Pick Up Details.

races.name: Beer City San Francisco
races.summary: Join us on Saturday, April 11, 2027 at Little Marina Green for Beer City Half San Francisco! See the sights, run the river, and drink the brews that make San Francisco a Beer City all its own. Beer City Festival is a full day of fun. Drink local and dig it!

races.name: Corteau Vineyards Wine Run 5k
races.summary: Like Running or Walking? Love Wine? This race is for you! Join us on Saturday, April 11, 2027 at 9:00am for an fun event that features the amazing scenery and landscape of Corteau Vineyards! Come join us at a haven where the art of wine and the beauty of nature come together in perfect harmony.

races.name: Marblehead Half Marathon
races.summary: Join us for a scenic run through the beautiful and historic communities of Marblehead and Salem, Massachusetts. Enjoy spectacular coastal views as your run on both Marblehead Neck and Salem Willows.

races.name: Morgan Hill Aauw Wildflower Run
races.summary: The AAUW Wildflower Run raises money for scholarships and leadership programs for women & girls and community grants. (For information about our organization, go to www.aauwmh.org.) 10K Run, 5K Run, and 5K Walk are all on country roads with chip timing.

races.name: Platte River Half-Marathon, Relay & 5k
races.summary: Welcome to the Platte River Half Marathon, Relay & 5k race, one of the most exciting and popular races in the Denver Metro Area! This race is held annually in Littleton, CO. We’re thrilled to announce that registration for our upcoming 2027 event on Sunday, April 11th is open for the half-marathon and relay race.

races.name: Sneakers & Sirens 5K
races.summary: Experience the inaugural Sneakers & Sirens 5K in the heart of the Kentlands in Gaithersburg, Maryland! This exciting community race benefits the Montgomery County Police and invites runners of all ages and abilities to come together for a morning of fitness, community spirit, and hometown pride.

races.name: Spring Fling Prairie Dog Half, 10k, & 5k
races.summary: Welcome to the SPRING FLING Prairie Dog Half, part of the Prairie Dog Half Race Series. This spring-time event also features 10k & 5k distances! If you're looking for race day info (including, schedule, course, packet pick up, etc) navigate to the menu under race info at the top!

races.name: Statesman Cap10K
races.summary: The 50th Statesman Capitol 10,000, Austin's big spring 10K.

races.name: 5K and Fun Day for Fragile X

Click Here for Event Details for Participants. This isn't your typical 5K. It is more of a choose your own adventure sort of day.

races.name: Badger Cove
races.summary: Half marathon, 10L and 5K.

races.name: 44th Annual Providence Saint John's Health Center Brentwood Run
races.summary: ‍♀️ Join Us for the 44th Annual Brentwood Run ‍♂️. Be part of a beloved Brentwood tradition as the 44th Annual Brentwood Run returns to San Vicente Blvd! Established in 1977, The Brentwood Run is Los Angeles' oldest road race. This historic race features an out and back course with a slight incline in the second half.

races.name: Cinderella Trail Run
races.summary: The course travels through beautiful Joaquin Miller & Redwood Regional parks. You'll wind through tall redwoods along popular Sequoia-Bayview and French trails. Then, come back to the finish down the very technical Cinderella trail. Some runners call it the Wicked Step Sisters trail.

races.name: Race To the Flag
races.summary: The Westmont Park District has partnered with the local nonprofit People’s Resource Center (PRC) so that proceeds from the race can benefit neighbors in need, right here in our community. As a partner in the community, PRC helps to meet neighbors’ basic needs such as food, shelter, and clothing assistance services.

races.name: BOLDERBoulder
races.summary: Colorado's Memorial Day 10K through the streets of Boulder. A virtual option is also offered.

races.name: Ringing in Hope: A Salute to our Troops
races.summary: important: Please note we are out of medals, but have dog tags. We also still have shirts that you can replace with your medal. Thank you for your support. Celebrate Memorial Day and honor our past and present military heroes!

races.name: Thummer's Memorial Day 5K
races.summary: Join us in celebrating National Military Appreciation Month with the Thummer's Memorial Day 5k at the LA County Fair. We will hold a pre-race memorial for USA service members who have lost their lives and run in their memory.

races.name: Northshore Spring 5k for Schools
races.summary: A Community 5K for Every Pace. A day of movement, connection, and community impact! The Northshore Spring 5K for Schools is proudly presented and hosted by the Northshore Schools Foundation, bringing our community together in support of local students and schools.

races.name: Chicago Beer Mile Championships
races.summary: Four beers. One mile. The Chicago Beer Mile will take place on Friday June 5th. Drink, Run, Drink, Repeat! This is a one-mile fun run for runners who enjoy beers. Drink a beer, run/walk/jog (or skip, crawl, whatever you want) your way a quarter mile around the track, and repeat three more times.

races.name: Baltimore 10 Miler
races.summary: The annual Summer Kick-Off Party! The Baltimore 10-Miler returns to Druid Hill Park just outside the Maryland Zoo. A challenging yet fair course, the 10-Miler takes participants through parts of Baltimore that are often not appreciated when driving through them.

races.name: Bright Star Community Outreach 5K Run/Walk - Hope in Action
races.summary: Join Bright Star Community Outreach (BSCO) for our 5K Run/Walk - Hope in Action fundraiser on Saturday, May 16, starting at 9:00 AM. This community-centered race will begin in Mandrake Park and continue along the beautiful lakefront, offering participants a scenic and energizing route.

races.name: Hansen Dam Splash 'n' Dash 1K/5K
races.summary: Get ready to kick off summer at the 2nd Annual Hansen Dam Splash & Dash 5K - a one-of-a-kind community race set against the scenic backdrop of Hansen Dam Recreation Area, home to one of the largest aquatic facilities in the country.

races.name: Lake Wilderness Triathlon and Run
races.summary: Lake Wilderness Triathlon is celebrating our 22nd year!! This event is scenic in all aspects of the race and has something for every level of participation. This is an excellent venue for a first time triathlete and the triathlete that's looking for some great competition.

races.name: Oneness 10K Run and 5K Run/Walk
races.summary: The Oneness Move proudly presents the 9th annual Oneness 10K Run and 5K Run/Walk! This event is entirely volunteer-run, and 100% of the funds raised go towards charity and scholarships. For more details on the Charitable initiatives of Oneness Move, please visit www.onenessmove.org.

races.name: Rock 'n' Roll San Diego
races.summary: The original Rock 'n' Roll race: marathon, half and 5K from Balboa Park to downtown San Diego, held June 5 to 6, 2027.

races.name: Ross Bogue Memorial Run the Hills 5k
races.summary: This event has raised over $100,000 for local food pantries and other non-profits. Participants are treated to an accurately measured 5k course with an aid station just before and after the turnaround point. Age group awards are given to the top three men and top three women in each category.

races.name: Squatch the Hook
races.summary: Two distances. Lake views below. Mountain views above. One unforgettable trail party! Sassquad Trail Running and the New York-New Jersey Trail Conference are proud to present Squatch the Hook: 5K/10K!

races.name: The Big Kahuna 5K, 10K - Austin
races.summary: Aloha, Runners! Welcome to The Big Kahuna ‍♀️. Grab your shades, lace up your shoes, and get ready to run the island way - The Big Kahuna is bringing tropical vibes, bright colors, and summer energy to the race course this June!

races.name: Walk & Roll Chicago
races.summary: Walk & Roll Chicago unites the community behind the American Cancer Society's efforts to save lives from cancer. It is a one-of-a-kind event that offers participants of all ages and skill levels a 5K Walk, 5K Timed Run, 10K Skate, or 15K Bike along Chicago's Lakefront Path.

races.name: Wfee Town Day Road Race
races.summary: The Town Day Road Race is a fundraiser for the Winchester Foundation for Educational Excellence (WFEE). All monies raised support public school educators and students through grants to encourage creativity and innovation. Run or walk, the Race is a fun, family centered event.

races.name: Wrigley River Run & Tadpole Trot
races.summary: Visit www.wrigleyriverrun.com for full event information. The start/finish, expo area and bib pick up will be located in the parking lot of Westland Real Estate Group/Long Beach Beer Lab, at 520 W Willow St, Long Beach, CA 90806.

races.name: 4th Annual Norwalk 5K
races.summary: Norwalk 5K Run - June 6, 2027. Get ready to break a sweat at the 4th Annual Norwalk 5K Run on Sunday, June 6!

races.name: Black Hat Brew 5k
races.summary: Join us for the first Black Hat Brew 5k! Start at the gym, finish at the brewery! Talk about convenient neighbors! The 5k will kick off right at 11am from Scotland Blvd, finishing at the start line, celebrating at the brewery to kick off summer!

races.name: Colorado 13er (Half Marathon/10k/5k)
races.summary: The Colorado 13er is THE event where the best parts of trail running and road racing combine to create a truly enjoyable, kind-to-your-body, well-supported 13.1 race!

races.name: Elgin Valley Fox Trot
races.summary: Come help us celebrate the 50th Elgin Valley Fox Trot 10-Mile and 5K races which will take place in Elgin on June 6, 2027. The Fox Trot is one of the longest continuous and most popular running events in the region and is known for its scenic and challenging courses.

races.name: Flamingo Day 5K
races.summary: Get ready to stand on one leg-or run on two! Join us at Sloan’s Lake Park for Denver’s brightest, pinkest, and most festive 5K of the season. Whether you’re chasing a personal record, walking with friends, or just here to show off your best flamingo gear, this loop around the lake is built for maximum fun.

races.name: Griffith Park Trail Marathon Relay & 8K
races.summary: Join us for the Griffith Park Trail Marathon Relay & 8K, an unforgettable race experience celebrated as one of Runner’s World magazine’s 10 Best Races You’ve Never Heard Of in 2024! This iconic event is the perfect opportunity to push yourself, bond with friends, and take in the breathtaking beauty of Griffith Park.

races.name: Lake Chabot Trail Challenge (Half Marathon & 5K)
races.summary: RACE INFO: We are so excited to celebrate the 43rd annual Lake Chabot Trail Challenge Half Marathon and 5K. This race is well regarded amongst serious trail runners in the outlying areas. The race begins at 8am for the Half Marathon and 8:30am for the 5K.

races.name: Twin Lobster Half Marathon
